Choose the sentence with the same meaning as the following.
I exercise alone every weekday.
I finished the meeting and went home right away.
This shop does not sell fruit.
I stopped by home before the meeting.
I went straight home after the meeting ended.
Choose the sentence with the same meaning.
A weekday exercise habit differs in both topic and action from going home after a meeting ended.
Whether a shop sells fruit has nothing to do with going home after a meeting ended.
“전에” (before) places the action before the meeting, reversing the order in the original “끝난 후에” (after it ended). “들렀습니다” (stopped by) also describes a different action from going straight home.

【Answer rationale】The original “회의가 끝난 후에 바로 집에 갔습니다” means going straight home once the meeting ended. “회의를 마치고 곧 집으로 갔습니다” has the same event order and action: finishing the meeting and going home right away. The correct expression is “회의를 마치고 곧 집으로 갔습니다.” (I finished the meeting and went home right away.)
【Distractor trap】The main trap reverses “후에” (after) into “전에” (before). The exercise and fruit-sales options are unrelated to the meeting and going home.
【Strategy for this question type】Briefly mark the subject, action and time order when choosing equivalent meanings. Here, keep only the option preserving both “meeting ends → immediate return home.”
In the current option order, choice 2 is correct.
